title.zh: 卷五 本紀第五: 世宗
title.raw: 卷五 本紀第五: 世宗 Volume 5 Annals 5: Shizong

sentences.zh: 世宗孝和莊憲皇帝，諱阮，小字兀欲。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizong, posthumously Xiaohé Zhuangxian, personal name Ruan, childhood name Wuyu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong, posthumously Xiaohé Zhuangxian, bore the personal name Ruan and the childhood name Wuyu.

sentences.zh: 讓國皇帝長子，母柔貞皇后蕭氏。

translations.literal: He was the eldest son of the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm; his mother was Empress Rouzhen, née Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: He was the eldest son of the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm, and his mother was Empress Rouzhen of the Xiao clan.

sentences.zh: 帝儀觀豐偉，內寬外嚴，善騎射，樂施予，人望歸之。

translations.literal: The emperor was imposing in bearing, lenient within and stern without, skilled at horsemanship and archery, delighted in giving, and the people's hopes turned to him.
translations.idiomatic: He was imposing in bearing, lenient at heart yet stern in demeanor, skilled at horsemanship and archery, generous by nature, and the people looked to him with hope.

sentences.zh: 太宗愛之如子。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong loved him as a son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong loved him as his own son.

sentences.zh: 會同九年，從伐晉。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Huitong he followed the campaign against Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Huitong he took part in the campaign against Jin.

sentences.zh: 大同元年春二月，封永康王。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring in the first year of Datong he was enfeoffed as Prince Yongkang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the first year of Datong he was enfeoffed as Prince Yongkang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，太宗崩於欒城。

translations.literal: That summer, on dingchou day of the fourth month, Emperor Taizong died at Luancheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month that summer, on dingchou day, Emperor Taizong died at Luancheng.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，梓宮次鎮陽，即皇帝位於柩前。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the coffin halted at Zhenyang, and he took the throne before the bier.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the imperial coffin paused at Zhenyang, and he took the throne before the bier.

sentences.zh: 甲申，次定州，命天德、朔古、解裏等護梓宮先赴上京。

translations.literal: On jiashen day he halted at Ding Prefecture and ordered Tiande, Shuogu, Jieli, and others to escort the coffin ahead to the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day he stopped at Ding Prefecture and ordered Tiande, Shuogu, Jieli, and others to escort the coffin on to the Supreme Capital first.

sentences.zh: 太后聞帝即位，遣太弟李胡率兵拒之。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager heard the Emperor had succeeded, she sent Li Hu, the Imperial Younger Brother, with troops to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that the Emperor had succeeded, the Empress Dowager sent Li Hu, the Imperial Younger Brother, with an army to oppose him.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅朔，次南京，五院夷離堇安端、詳穩劉哥遣人馳報，請為前鋒；

translations.literal: On the jiayin new moon of the sixth month he halted at the Southern Capital; Five Courts yilijin Anduan and xiangwen Liu Ge sent swift messengers asking to serve as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the sixth month he reached the Southern Capital; Five Courts yilijin Anduan and xiangwen Liu Ge sent riders in haste to offer themselves as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 至泰德泉，遇李胡軍，戰敗之。

translations.literal: Reaching Taide Spring, he met Li Hu's army and defeated it.
translations.idiomatic: At Taide Spring he met Li Hu's army and routed it.

sentences.zh: 上遣郎君勤德等詣兩軍諭解。

translations.literal: The Emperor sent langjun Qinde and others to both armies to counsel reconciliation.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sent langjun Qinde and others to both camps to urge a settlement.

sentences.zh: 秋閏七月，次潢河，太后、李胡整兵拒於橫渡，相持數日。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month of autumn, the seventh month, he halted at the Huang River; the Empress Dowager and Li Hu arrayed troops to resist at Hengdu Ford, and they faced off for several days.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh autumn month he halted at the Huang River; the Empress Dowager and Li Hu arrayed troops to resist at Hengdu Ford, and the two sides faced off for several days.

sentences.zh: 用屋質之謀，各罷兵趨上京。

translations.literal: Following Wuzhi's plan, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Following Wuzhi's counsel, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 既而聞太后、李胡復有異謀，遷於祖州。

translations.literal: Soon after, hearing the Empress Dowager and Li Hu were plotting again, he had them moved to Zu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, hearing that the Empress Dowager and Li Hu were plotting again, he had them moved to Zu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 誅司徒劃設及楚補裏。

translations.literal: Minister over the Masses Huashe and Chubuli were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: He executed Minister over the Masses Huashe and Chubuli.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午朔，尊母蕭氏為皇太后，以太后族剌只撒古魯為國舅帳，立詳穩以總焉。

translations.literal: On the renwu new moon of the eighth month he honored his mother Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager, made the empress dowager's clansman Laji Saguolu head of the imperial maternal-uncle account, and appointed a xiangwen to oversee it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the eighth month he honored his mother, Lady Xiao, as Empress Dowager, made the empress dowager's kinsman Laji Saguolu head of the imperial maternal-uncle account, and set a xiangwen over it.

sentences.zh: 以崇德宮戶分賜翼戴功臣，及北院大王窪、南院大王吼各五十，安摶、楚補各百。

translations.literal: Households from the Palace of Honored Virtue were divided and bestowed on meritorious supporters; Northern Chancellor Wa and Southern Chancellor Hou each received fifty; Anpo and Chubu each a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Households from the Palace of Honored Virtue were divided and bestowed on those who had raised him to the throne; Northern Chancellor Wa and Southern Chancellor Hou each received fifty, and Anpo and Chubu each a hundred.

sentences.zh: 的魯、鐵剌子孫先以非罪籍沒者歸之。

translations.literal: Descendants of Dilu and Tiela, earlier registered and confiscated without crime, were restored to them.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of Dilu and Tiela, earlier registered and confiscated though guilty of no crime, were restored to them.

sentences.zh: 癸未，始置北院樞密使，以安摶為之。

translations.literal: On guiwei day the Northern Palace Commissioner was first established, with Anpo appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the Northern Palace Commissioner was established for the first time, with Anpo appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子朔，葬嗣聖皇帝於懷陵。

translations.literal: On the renzi new moon of the ninth month the Succeeding Sage Emperor was buried at Huai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the ninth month the Succeeding Sage Emperor was interred at Huai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，行柴冊禮，群臣上尊號曰天授皇帝。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the firewood-and-script rites were performed; the assembled ministers offered the honorific title Emperor Who Received Heaven's Mandate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the firewood-and-script rites were performed, and the assembled ministers offered the honorific title Emperor Who Received Heaven's Mandate.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改大同元年為天祿元年。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was granted, and the first year of Datong was changed to the first year of Tianlu.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the first year of Datong to the first year of Tianlu.

sentences.zh: 追謚皇考曰讓國皇帝。

translations.literal: His deceased father was posthumously titled Emperor Who Yielded the Realm.
translations.idiomatic: He gave his late father the posthumous title Emperor Who Yielded the Realm.

sentences.zh: 以安端主東丹國，封明王，察割為泰寧王，劉哥為惕隱，高勛為南院樞密使。

translations.literal: Anduan was made to rule the Dongdan state and enfeoffed as Prince of Ming; Chage as Prince of Taining; Liu Ge as tiyin; Gao Xun as Southern Palace Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Anduan was set to rule the Dongdan state and enfeoffed as Prince of Ming; Chage was made Prince of Taining; Liu Ge was made tiyin; and Gao Xun was made Southern Palace Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，天德、蕭翰、劉哥、盆都等謀反。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, Tiande, Xiao Han, Liu Ge, Pendu, and others plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year, first month, Tiande, Xiao Han, Liu Ge, Pendu, and others plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 誅天德，杖蕭翰，遷劉哥於邊，罰盆都使轄戛斯國。

translations.literal: Tiande was executed, Xiao Han was beaten with the staff, Liu Ge was transferred to the frontier, and Pendu was punished by being sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.
translations.idiomatic: Tiande was executed, Xiao Han was flogged, Liu Ge was transferred to the frontier, and Pendu was punished by being sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.

sentences.zh: 漢主劉知遠殂，子承祐立。

translations.literal: Han ruler Liu Zhiyuan died, and his son Chengyou succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Han ruler Liu Zhiyuan died, and his son Chengyou succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰朔，南唐遣李朗、王祚來慰且賀，兼奉蠟丸書，議攻漢。

translations.literal: On the gengchen new moon of the fourth summer month Southern Tang sent Li Lang and Wang Zuo to offer condolences and congratulations, also presenting a wax-ball dispatch to discuss attacking Han.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the fourth summer month Southern Tang sent Li Lang and Wang Zuo with condolences and congratulations, also presenting a wax-ball dispatch to discuss an attack on Han.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，皇子賢生。

translations.literal: On renshen day in the seventh autumn month Prince Xian was born.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on renshen day, Prince Xian was born.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，南京留守魏王趙延壽薨，以中臺省右相牒哷葛為南京留守，封燕王。

translations.literal: On renwu day in the tenth winter month Zhao Yanshou, Prince Wei and regent of the Southern Capital, died; Central Secretariat Right Chancellor Dielige was made regent of the Southern Capital and enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the tenth winter month Zhao Yanshou, Prince Wei and regent of the Southern Capital, died; Dielige, right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, was made regent of the Southern Capital and enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.

sentences.zh: 十一月，駐蹕彰武南。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he halted the imperial progress south of Zhangwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he halted the imperial progress south of Zhangwu.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月，蕭翰及公主阿不裏謀反，翰伏誅，阿不裏瘐死獄中。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, Xiao Han and Princess Abuli plotted rebellion; Han was executed, and Abuli died of illness in prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year, first month, Xiao Han and Princess Abuli plotted rebellion; Han was executed, and Abuli wasted away and died in prison.

sentences.zh: 庚申，肆赦。

translations.literal: On gengshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day he proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 內外官各進一階。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials alike were promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Every civil and military official was promoted one step in rank.

sentences.zh: 夏六月戊寅，以敞史耶律胡離軫為北院大王。

translations.literal: That summer, on wuyin day of the sixth month, Yelü Hulizhen, chamberlain of records, was made Northern Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on wuyin day of the sixth month, Yelü Hulizhen, chamberlain of records, was made Northern Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，惕隱頹昱封漆水郡王。

translations.literal: On jimao day tiyin Tuibai was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day tiyin Tuibai was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui commandery.

sentences.zh: 秋九月辛丑朔，召群臣議南伐。

translations.literal: On the xinchou new moon of the ninth autumn month the ministers were summoned to discuss a southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the ninth autumn month he summoned the ministers to deliberate on a southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，遣諸將率兵攻下貝州高老鎮，徇地鄴都、南宮、堂陽，殺深州刺史史萬山，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month generals were dispatched with troops to capture Gaolao town in Bei Prefecture, marched through Yedu, Nangong, and Tangyang, killed Shen Prefecture prefect Shi Wanshan, and took many captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter he sent generals with troops to take Gaolao town in Bei Prefecture, raided through Yedu, Nangong, and Tangyang, killed Shen Prefecture prefect Shi Wanshan, and captured a great host.

sentences.zh: 四年春二月辛未，泰寧王察割來朝，留侍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, second month, on xinwei day Prince of Taining Chage came to court and was kept in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, spring, second month, on xinwei day Prince of Taining Chage came to court and was kept in attendance at court.

sentences.zh: 是月，建政事省。

translations.literal: That month the Directorate of Government Affairs was established.
translations.idiomatic: That month he established the Directorate of Government Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌朔，南唐遣趙延嗣、張福等來賀南征捷。

translations.literal: On the wuxu new moon of the third month Southern Tang sent Zhao Yansi, Zhang Fu, and others to congratulate him on the southern campaign's victory.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the third month Southern Tang sent Zhao Yansi, Zhang Fu, and others to congratulate him on the southern campaign's victory.

sentences.zh: 秋九月乙丑朔，如山西。

translations.literal: On the yichou new moon of the ninth autumn month he went to Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou new moon of the ninth autumn month he traveled to Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，自將南伐，攻下安平、內丘、束鹿等城，大獲而還。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month he personally led a southern campaign, captured Anping, Neiqiu, Shulu, and other cities, and returned with great spoils.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter he personally led a southern campaign, took Anping, Neiqiu, Shulu, and other cities, and returned laden with booty.

sentences.zh: 是歲，冊皇后蕭氏。

translations.literal: That year Lady Xiao was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: That year he installed Lady Xiao as empress.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸亥朔，如百泉湖。

translations.literal: On the guihai new moon of the first spring month of the fifth year he went to Baiquan Lake.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the first spring month of the fifth year he went to Baiquan Lake.

sentences.zh: 漢郭威弒其主自立，國號周，遣朱憲來告。

translations.literal: Guo Wei of Han murdered his lord and declared himself emperor; his state name was Zhou, and he sent Zhu Xian to report it.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Wei of Han murdered his sovereign and declared himself emperor under the state name Zhou, then sent Zhu Xian to announce it.

sentences.zh: 即遣使致良馬。

translations.literal: At once envoys were dispatched presenting fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: He at once sent envoys presenting fine horses.

sentences.zh: 漢劉崇自立於太原。

translations.literal: Liu Chong of Han declared himself emperor at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chong of Han declared himself emperor at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 二月，周遣姚漢英、華昭胤來，以書辭抗禮，留漢英等。

translations.literal: In the second month Zhou sent Yao Hanying and Hua Zhaoyin; because their letter used language of equal standing, Hanying and the others were detained.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Zhou sent Yao Hanying and Hua Zhaoyin; because their letter used language asserting equal standing, Hanying and the others were detained.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬戌朔，太子太傅趙瑩薨，輟朝一日，命歸葬於汴。

translations.literal: On the renxu new moon of the fifth summer month Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhao Ying died; court was suspended for one day, and he was ordered buried at Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu new moon of the fifth summer month Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhao Ying died; court was suspended for one day, and he was ordered interred at Bian.

sentences.zh: 詔州縣錄事參軍、主簿委政事省銓註。

translations.literal: An edict entrusted the appointment of prefectural and county recorders and registrars to the Directorate of Government Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict entrusted the appointment of prefectural and county recorders and registrars to the Directorate of Government Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯朔，劉崇為周所攻，遣使稱，乞援，且求封冊。

translations.literal: On the xinmao new moon of the sixth month Liu Chong was attacked by Zhou; he sent envoys declaring submission, begging aid, and also requesting investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao new moon of the sixth month Liu Chong was attacked by Zhou; he sent envoys declaring submission, begging aid, and requesting formal investiture.

sentences.zh: 即遣燕王牒哷、樞密使高勛冊為大漢神武皇帝。

translations.literal: At once Prince of Yan Dielie and Palace Secretariat Commissioner Gao Xun were dispatched to invest him as Emperor Shenwu of Great Han.
translations.idiomatic: He at once sent Prince of Yan Dielie and Palace Secretariat Commissioner Gao Xun to invest him as Emperor Shenwu of Great Han.

sentences.zh: 南唐遣蔣洪來，乞舉兵應援。

translations.literal: Southern Tang sent Jiang Hong, begging that troops be raised in support.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Tang sent Jiang Hong, begging that troops be raised in support.

sentences.zh: 是夏，清暑百泉嶺。

translations.literal: That summer he escaped the heat at Baiquan Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he escaped the heat at Baiquan Ridge.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申朔，自將南伐。

translations.literal: On the gengshen new moon of the ninth month he personally led a southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the ninth month he personally led a southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，次歸化州祥古山。

translations.literal: On renxu day he halted at Xianggu Mountain in Guihua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day he halted at Xianggu Mountain in Guihua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，祭讓國皇帝於行宮。

translations.literal: On guihai day he sacrificed to the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day he sacrificed to the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 群臣皆醉，察割反，帝遇弒，年三十四。

translations.literal: All the ministers were drunk; Chage rebelled, and the emperor was assassinated, aged thirty-four.
translations.idiomatic: All the ministers were drunk; Chage rebelled, and the emperor was assassinated at the age of thirty-four.

sentences.zh: 應歷元年，葬於顯州西山，陵曰顯陵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yingli he was buried on the western hills of Xian Prefecture; the mausoleum was called Xian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yingli he was buried on the western hills of Xian Prefecture; the mausoleum was called Xian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 二年，謚孝和皇帝，廟號世宗。

translations.literal: In the second year he was posthumously titled Emperor Xiaohé, with temple name Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was posthumously titled Emperor Xiaohé, with the temple name Shizong.

sentences.zh: 統和二十六年七月，加謚孝和莊憲皇帝。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe his posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Xiaohé Zhuangxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe his posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Xiaohé Zhuangxian.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：世宗中才之主也，入繼大統，曾未三年，納唐丸書，即議南伐，即乏持重，宜乖周防，蓋有致禍之道矣。

translations.literal: The eulogy says: Shizong was a ruler of middling talent. Having succeeded to the great mandate, within barely three years he accepted Tang's wax-sealed letter and at once debated a southern campaign — lacking steadiness, contrary to circumspection; he surely had the ways that bring ruin.
translations.idiomatic: The eulogy says: Shizong was a ruler of middling talent. Having succeeded to the great mandate, within barely three years he accepted Tang's wax-sealed letter and at once debated a southern campaign — lacking steadiness and contrary to circumspection; he surely had within him the ways that bring ruin.

sentences.zh: 然而孝友寬慈，亦有君人之度焉。

translations.literal: Yet he was filial, friendly, lenient, and kind, and possessed something of a ruler's measure.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in filial piety, brotherly affection, lenience, and kindness he still showed a measure fit for a ruler.

sentences.zh: 未及師還，變起沈湎，豈不可哀也哉！

translations.literal: Before the army could return, upheaval arose from deep drinking — how could it not be lamentable!
translations.idiomatic: Before the army could return, upheaval arose from deep drinking — how could it not be lamentable!
